name: Adeept ADR036 4WD Smart Car Kit for Raspberry Pi
description: The first curated OpenVibe robot: the Adeept 4WD Smart Car with the Robot HAT — four DC motors and pan/tilt servos on a PCA9685, an ADS7830 battery readout, WS2812 lights, a buzzer, ultrasound and line tracking. The OpenVibe Node agent drives the HAT directly, so the kit's stock control server is never exposed.

parts.name: Adeept ADR036 4WD Smart Car Kit (acrylic chassis and hardware)
parts.note: Adeept's tutorial download page is the build guide

parts.name: Adeept Robot HAT (PCA9685 motor/servo driver, ADS7830 battery ADC)
parts.note: Comes with the kit; also charges the 18650 pack over USB-C

parts.name: Raspberry Pi 4B or 5 (2 GB or more)
parts.note: Not included in the Adeept kit

parts.name: 18650 Li-ion cells
parts.note: The Robot HAT charges the pack over USB-C
